abstract: We show that, given a very general cubic threefold $X$, any smooth cubic threefold stably birational to $X$ must be isomorphic to $X$. The method applies as well to other Fano 3-folds, like the sextic double solid, and the quartic threefold. We also discuss the higher-dimensional case.
hook: A very general cubic threefold is stably birational only to copies of itself.
hook_turn: stably birational only to copies of itself.
summary: Voisin shows that any smooth cubic threefold stably birational to a very general one must be isomorphic to it, and the method also covers the sextic double solid and quartic threefold. This is an algebraic geometry proof. It covers very general members only, not every cubic threefold.
title: On the stable birational type of Fano threefolds
